limitations_and_boundaries: Stochastic sampling requires heuristic choices (S_churn, S_tmin, S_tmax, S_noise) that depend on the specific model and must be found via grid search.
The improvements are demonstrated on image generation tasks; applicability to other domains is not tested.
The preconditioning and training improvements are evaluated only with the proposed deterministic sampler; interaction with stochastic sampling is not fully explored.
The paper focuses on denoising score matching models; other diffusion model variants may not benefit equally.

methods.name: Preconditioning (Eq. 7)
methods.protocol_description: Precondition network with σ-dependent skip connection: D_θ(x;σ) = c_skip(σ) x + c_out(σ) F_θ(c_in(σ) x; c_noise(σ)). Functions derived to keep input/output unit variance and minimize error amplification.

methods.name: Loss weighting and noise level sampling
methods.protocol_description: Set λ(σ) = 1/c_out(σ)^2 to balance effective loss weights. Use log-normal distribution for p_train(σ) to focus on intermediate noise levels.

methods.name: Augmentation regularization
methods.protocol_description: Apply geometric augmentations before adding noise; condition F_θ on augmentation parameters; set to zero during inference.
